title: Boba Fett's final step
description: In the Tusken Raider encampment, his young friend excitedly welcomed Boba Fett back. The chieftain opened the tiny basket, drawing the lizard back out from Fett's nostril. Boba raised the branch he broke off from the tree, and having passed the trial, he is draped and dressed in tusken robes. In his final rite of passage, he meticulously carved his branch into his very own custom gaffi stick. Boba Fett was now part of the tribe.
